articles.title: Ripple is worth $90 a share to one fund and $300 to another, SEC filings show
articles.snippet: Two SEC-registered funds open to ordinary investors marked Ripple stock 70% apart on Sept. 30, and the lower mark sits barely above what the other fund paid in 2018.

articles.title: Take-Two Hits GTA 6 PC Port Leonida With DMCA, Taking Down 3,007 GitHub Repos
articles.snippet: Rockstar's parent said the project's "bring your own files" instruction was a misleading attempt to dodge responsibility for the leak.
